core_change_summary.description: In packages/workshop-utils/src/apps.server.ts, implement minimum cache time and cache app running states to reduce thrashing; in cache.server.ts, increase cache capacity; in utils.tsx and index.tsx, parallelize directory scans and use cached states; a performance-analysis.md documents findings.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: performance-analysis.md is a documentation file summarizing the analysis; no other secondary files.
